title: Teeth whitening and cleaning in Mohandessin
description: Compare teeth whitening, scaling and polishing in Mohandessin. Learn which stains can change, how restorations affect shade and how to manage sensitivity.
h1: Teeth whitening and cleaning in Mohandessin
answer: Scaling and polishing remove deposits and surface stains, while whitening aims to lighten natural tooth colour. At {{brand}} in Mohandessin, adults concerned about tooth shade can discuss which approach fits their teeth and gums. Existing crowns and fillings do not whiten and may influence your choice.
preparation: Tell us about sensitivity, exposed roots and front tooth restorations. Decay or inflamed gums may need attention before whitening.
howPerformed: We assess the source of staining, remove deposits if indicated and discuss whether a separate whitening step is appropriate.
followup: Sensitivity or gum tenderness can follow treatment. Ask about cleaning products and review persistent pain before repeating whitening.
risks: Whitening may irritate gums or increase sensitivity, and the shade can differ between natural teeth and restorations.

faqs.a: Scaling may feel sensitive and whitening can cause brief sharp sensitivity in some teeth.
